name: clinicalomicsdb

fields.name: clinical_response / residual_tumor (label column in expression CSV)

primary_key.field: study_id (composite with analyte/gene for association rows)

license.observed_site: Not independently re-stated on trials.linkedomics.org pages checked (site pages returned 403 to automated fetch; API endpoints and Box.com CSV links themselves carry no separate license banner)
restrictions: Non-commercial re-use per journal license; commercial re-use requires OUP permission

redundant_fields: raw gene expression values (already covered indirectly by GEO but not by any core BioThings API)

endpoints: POST filter/ — get full study_list (optionally filtered by drugs/cancers)
GET info/{study} — study metadata + Box.com download_url for raw expression CSV
GET table/study/gene/{study} — per-gene significance stats (p, auc, fdr) for one study
GET table/study/gene_set/{study} — per-gene-set significance stats for one study
GET table/gene/{gene} — cross-study stats for one gene
GET table/gene_set/{gene_set} — cross-study stats for one gene set
POST table/treatment_gene/ and table/treatment_gene_set/ — meta-analysis across a chosen study_list
api_crawl_details.pagination: none — POST filter/ returns the complete study_list (40 studies) in a single response; per-study table endpoints return full arrays
api_crawl_details.rate_limits: unknown (not documented on site or in OpenAPI spec)
api_crawl_details.response_shape: bare JSON array for table/ endpoints; JSON object for info/{study} and filter/ endpoints

paper_vs_reality.claim: 40 clinical trial studies, 5,913 patients, 11 cancer types, 67 treatment arms, 33 drugs
paper_vs_reality.observed: Confirmed consistent via live API: filter/ and info/{study} endpoints return matching per-study sample sizes and treatment/disease fields for spot-checked studies (GSE14764, Choueiri_CCR_2016)

paper_vs_reality.claim: Public REST API with R package access
paper_vs_reality.observed: Confirmed live: https://trials.linkedomics.org/api/ responds with JSON to unauthenticated curl requests; OpenAPI 3.1 spec published at https://trials.linkedomics.org/trials_api.json

paper_vs_reality.claim: Data stored in SQLite, downloadable as CSV
paper_vs_reality.observed: Confirmed: info/{study} endpoint returns a download_url pointing to a per-study CSV hosted on Box.com, verified accessible without auth

Could not independently re-verify a separate license statement on trials.linkedomics.org itself — site's static pages (e.g. /about/, /browse/, /programmatic_access/) returned HTTP 403 to the automated fetch tool, though raw JSON/API assets under the same domain were reachable via curl

risks: Homepage HTML pages (e.g. /about/, /browse/) blocked automated WebFetch with 403, though the underlying API and OpenAPI spec JSON were reachable directly via curl — site may have bot-detection on rendered pages only
Disease/cancer type is free text without a controlled ontology ID (no MONDO/DOID) in the API response, requiring a manual mapping table for BioThings disease linkage

Per-study CSV files are served via dynamically-issued Box.com static links rather than a stable bulk archive; a full crawl requires calling info/{study} for all 40 studies first to collect current download_url values before fetching
Potential redundancy with unconfirmed source composition of pending.api 'Multiomics Drug Response KP' / 'Multiomics Clinical Trials' KPs (see relevancy risks)
